post.description: Pull a complete publication county by county: every county's tax base and tax distribution, every county's class-by-class summary for two tax years, or every county's quarterly oil and gas collections, distributions and fund split.

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

cursor.description: `next_cursor` of the previous page. Carries the publication; the edition inputs may be repeated but are not needed.

fiscal_year.description:
`oil_gas_distribution` only, with `quarter`; default newest.

Provider reference: minimum 2000; maximum 2100.

limit.description:
Records per page. Default 10. County summary records are large (about 90 rows each); use a small limit.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 60.

quarter.description:
`oil_gas_distribution` only, with `fiscal_year`.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 4.

report.description:
Which publication; see `source_status`.

Provider reference: allowed values ["tax_base", "county_summaries", "oil_gas_distribution"].

tax_year.description:
`tax_base` only; default newest.

Provider reference: minimum 2000; maximum 2100.

200.description:
Download one publication (the latest edition or the one asked for) and return its county sections as records, `limit` at a time in publication order (tax base: counties by Department of Revenue number then Statewide; county summaries: State Total then counties alphabetically; oil and gas: counties alphabetically then the state accounts). Each record carries the publication id, file URL and retrieval time, the county's canonical name and number, the parsed table rows and the arithmetic differences found. The cursor pins the file URL, ETag and SHA-256: when the file changes between pages the call fails with `invalid_input` (`publication_changed` at `/cursor`) so that pages from two editions are never mixed. The whole file is downloaded on every call.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| `etag` | string |  |

| `report` | string |  |
| `retrieved_at` | string |  |
| `sha256` | string |  |
| `source_url` | string |  |
| `total` | number | Records in the publication. |

post.description: Check whether a publication changed (compare `sha256` or `etag`), see which tax years, bienniums or quarters are available, or get the statewide totals cheaply before paging through counties.

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

edition.description: `county_summaries` only: the biennium as `YYYY-YYYY` (`2022-2024` is the report for July 1, 2022 to June 30, 2024). Retired editions are looked up in the document archive catalog. Default: the edition on the biennial reports page.

fiscal_year.description:
`oil_gas_distribution` only, with `quarter`: the state fiscal year of the `{fy}-Q{q}-County-Distribution.pdf` file. Default: the newest quarter listed.

Provider reference: minimum 2000; maximum 2100.

quarter.description:
`oil_gas_distribution` only, with `fiscal_year`: the fiscal quarter (Q1 ends September 30, Q2 December 31, Q3 March 31, Q4 June 30; the report prints the quarter ending date it covers).

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 4.

report.description:
`tax_base`: County and Statewide Tax Base and Tax Distribution (annual, by tax year). `county_summaries`: Biennial Report Appendix, County Summaries (by biennium edition such as `2022-2024`). `oil_gas_distribution`: Oil and Gas County Distribution (by fiscal year and quarter).

Provider reference: allowed values ["tax_base", "county_summaries", "oil_gas_distribution"].

tax_year.description:
`tax_base` only: the tax year in the index page URL (`/property/{year}-County-and-Statewide-Tax-Base-and-Tax-Distribution-Information`). Default: the newest year in the site map.

Provider reference: minimum 2000; maximum 2100.

200.description:
Resolve one publication (the latest edition, or the tax year, biennium edition or fiscal quarter asked for) from the Department of Revenue index pages, download the PDF and describe it: final URL, size, ETag, Last-Modified, SHA-256 of the bytes, page count, the tax years or quarter it covers, the number of county sections it parses into, the publication-level totals and arithmetic warnings, and the other editions the index pages list. No records are returned; call `records_list` for them.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| --- | --- | --- |
| `available_editions` | string[] | Other editions the index pages list, newest first: tax years (`2023`), bienniums (`2022-2024`) or quarters (`FY2027-Q1`). |
